messages:
noah: Promo blocked: CI matrix failing on artifact-cache checksum drift after matrix parallelism bump. deploy-bot auto-paused.
ci-bot: [alert] 9/20 matrix shards returned mismatched checksums for artifact bundle `app-build-2026-03-22.tar.gz`. Parallelism recently increased from 20 -> 40.
deploy-bot: Policy 'artifact_integrity' triggered. Promotion suspended until manual review.
kevin: Saw similar on a different pipeline last week; usually disk pressure + parallel fetches cause partial uploads. Any recent storage maintenance?
tanvi: Storage team did a rolling reencode on the object store at 03:10 UTC. Could be related. I'll ping infra.
ops-lee: Checking object-store logs. I see rapid GET retries from many agents and some 499 client disconnects. Also node `/mnt/ephemeral` reported low space on a few workers.
noah: Options: 1) pin to last-green and abort this promo, 2) hotflip matrix parallelism down to 20 and retry, or 3) reupload artifacts and retry. Thoughts?
kevin: Prefer hotflip -> retry. If retry still fails, pin to last-green and schedule reupload. Hotflip is lowest customer-impact.
tanvi: Agreed. I'll create a tiny pipeline patch to set matrix.concurrency=20 and add `artifact: retry: 3` to fetch step.
ci-bot: Patch branch `ci/matrix-concurrency-20` created. Manual trigger required due to protected branch policy.
deploy-bot: During change window, manual hotflip needs two release-council approvals.
release-council: We approve the concurrency hotflip as an emergency patch. Approvers: @release-council (sufficient). Proceed with canary run, do not unpause global promo until canary green.
noah: Triggering canary job 99012 for subset of shards. Link: https://ci.internal/builds/99012
ci-bot: Canary started. Monitoring logs.
ops-lee: While canary runs, I'm kicking off an integrity check on object-store for the affected key prefix and verifying checksums against source CI artifacts. ETA 45m.
kevin: If canary fails, we should immediately pin to `release-2026-03-21-lastgreen` and notify downstream owners. Also draft release note: "Promo held: artifact checksum drift observed; reduced CI concurrency and performed artifact integrity verification. If reupload required, customers will be notified."
tanvi: Canary logs show fetch completion and no truncated tars so far. One flaky worker still has `/var/log/ci/transfer.err` showing `unexpected EOF`. Excluding that worker from pool for canary.
ci-bot: Canary job 99012 finished: 18/20 shards OK, 2 shards failed on a single excluded worker.
noah: Good — can we rerun failed shards against alternate workers? If they pass, we can unpause.
ops-lee: Rerun against alternate nodes: job 99013 -> all shards verified. Object-store integrity check shows 2 partial multipart uploads during rolling reencode window; those were quarantined and reassembled.
deploy-bot: With successful verification, promotion can proceed but must include a release note and postmortem action. Manual unpause accepted.
release-council: Approve staged resume. Requirement: add changelog entry and create a follow-up ticket for object-store multipart handling.
noah: Will update promo ticket: status -> resumed, note -> reduced concurrency for retry, integrity checks passed, follow-up created (#PI-4523).
kevin: Drafting release note blurb: "Release temporarily paused due to artifact checksum inconsistencies during CI matrix run; CI concurrency reduced and artifact integrity verification performed. Promotion resumed after verification. Follow-up: investigate object-store multipart handling during rolling re-encodes."
tanvi: I'll add the pipeline change to the canary commit message and revert the concurrency bump in mainline once the object-store fix ships.
ops-lee: Creating follow-up: PI-4523 with logs and repro steps. Also enabling ephemeral-disk eviction alert to catch low-space earlier.
noah: Thanks team. Closing the hold. I'll push the release-note and mark the rollout as resumed. :tada:
